name: omnisense/omniplay
description: Omniplay: games under any PHP host, behind contracts by capability. On the stores: a game's record (texts, dates, studios, platforms, price, pictures, scores, identifiers on other stores), a search by title, a player's library and whether a player owns a game, read only. Online play, whatever the game's engine or netcode: a fleet of game servers kept by their heartbeats, a player seated on a fitting server with a short-lived signed ticket the server checks by itself, hosting providers that start and stop servers, a player's identity verified by their platform. Providers are packages of their own (omniplay/steam, omniplay/gog, omniplay/itch, omniplay/igdb, omniplay/rawg, omniplay/docker, omniplay/edgegap, and inside the game server omniplay/dotnet, mirror, netcode, godot and node); the ticket's format and its vectors are documented for a server in any language; the Symfony and Laravel bridges live in omnibridge.

suggest.omniplay/steam: Steam: the store's records and search (no key), a player's library and ownership (Web API key), a player's session ticket verified on the platform (publisher key)
suggest.omniplay/gog: GOG: the catalogue's records and search (no key)
suggest.omniplay/itch: itch.io: a game page's record (no key), whether a player owns one of your games (API key)
suggest.omniplay/igdb: IGDB: the catalogue, with identifiers on the stores (Twitch client credentials)
suggest.omniplay/rawg: RAWG: the catalogue, with the stores selling a game (API key)
suggest.omniplay/docker: Docker: game-server containers started and stopped through the Docker Engine API (a unix socket or TCP)
suggest.omniplay/edgegap: Edgegap: game servers deployed near the players through Edgegap's REST API, stopped by their request id
suggest.omnisense/omnibridge: The host contracts; omnibridge/symfony and omnibridge/laravel wire omniplay into their host when a site needs it
